research.title: Grab Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of grab.com
research.snippet: Grab maintains a "Bad" rating (1.3/5 stars). Reviewers frequently complain about "exorbitant fees," "high surge pricing," and "hidden charges" that appear after booking.
research.details: Users highlight a lack of transparency in how final fares are calculated and report that customer service rarely resolves pricing disputes or "overcharging" errors.

research.source: Tripadvisor Manila Forum: Grab vs. Taxi Pricing
research.title: Why taxi is cheaper than a car on Grab?
research.snippet: Travelers in the Philippines note that "GrabCar" (private vehicle) rates are consistently higher than metered street taxis or Grab's own "GrabTaxi" service, even after accounting for booking fees.
research.details: While users value the safety and fixed-price transparency of Grab, they explicitly challenge the "most affordable" claim by pointing out that traditional metered taxis remain a cheaper transport option.

research.title: Airport Transport-taxi or Grab?
research.snippet: Discussions regarding transport in Phuket reveal that Grab fares have become similar to local "taxi cartels" due to exclusive terminal access deals. Competitors such as Bolt and InDrive are cited as more affordable alternatives.
research.details: Mixed feedback suggests Grab is losing its "affordable" edge to newer market entrants, with pricing sometimes inflated by local transport monopolies.
